_legend.F: flam: quiet grace note a few ms before this step, then the normal hit

_rows.AC: accent (extra-loud layer on top of the other hits at that step)
_rows.TAM: tambourine (replaces another row in 5 Disco patterns)

_notes: Each track string has exactly `steps` characters, one per step, step 1 first. steps=16: sixteenth notes in 4/4. steps=12: triplet grid in 4/4 (step_feel=triplet), eighths in 12/8 (Blues), or sixteenths in 3/4 (Waltz). Only used rows are listed. Tempo is not specified by the source.
